mainEntity.name: Can TONTON develop custom camo rash guards with our brand artwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Send your authorized artwork, preferred colors, logo map, sleeve direction and quantities by size. Confirm panel alignment, print color, private labels and packaging on the approved sample.

mainEntity.name: Does this page establish an official KRYPTEK collaboration?

acceptedAnswer.text: No affiliation or licensing claim is made. Supplied reference images contain existing third-party marks and pattern names. Your order uses the artwork and rights approved for that project; the reference does not establish permission to reproduce third-party branding.

mainEntity.name: What fabric composition and GSM does this reference use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Confirm the selected compression-knit swatch, fiber composition, GSM, stretch recovery and opacity during quotation and sampling. No exact blend or weight is established for this reference by the supplied images.

mainEntity.name: Are the seams four-needle six-thread flatlock?

acceptedAnswer.text: The references show contrasting black seam lines and raglan panel joins. Request the four-needle six-thread flatlock direction if required, then confirm the actual stitch construction and skin-side finish on the physical sample.

mainEntity.name: Can this camo rash guard be used in No-Gi competition?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is presented as a training and custom-development reference. Check the relevant event, rank, division and date before approving colors, graphics and coverage for competition. No blanket competition approval is claimed.

mainEntity.name: What are the MOQ, size range and sample timing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selected projects start from 10 pieces. Confirm minimums per style, design and colorway, the size chart and quantity allocation. The selected-project sample target is 3–7 days after usable artwork and details are confirmed; sourcing and revisions can change the schedule.
